objects.description: No custom data types (structs, enums, typedefs, or classes) are defined in this header. The only symbol is a function declaration: const char* advobf_demo(void);

functions.name: advobf_demo
functions.description: Returns a C string provided by the advobf shim; intended as a simple demo/identification function. Call with no arguments and use the returned pointer as a read-only, NUL-terminated string. Exposed with C linkage for use from both C and C++ code. Exact contents, lifetime, and ownership of the returned string are not documented in the header and thus are unknown.
requirements: Treat the returned pointer as pointing to read-only data; do not modify the string contents
Check the returned pointer for NULL before dereferencing, as nullability is not documented
Do not attempt to free or deallocate the returned pointer unless other documentation explicitly states ownership transfer
Assume the returned data is a NUL-terminated C string if non-NULL
